profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Hi! A little bit about me, I graduated from UC San Diego with a Math/Computer Science B.S. and worked as a full stack developer mostly in Python, JavaScript, Node, React, GraphQL, MySQL, and AWS. But I am open to work with new technologies as I can pick it up very quickly. I wore multiple hats, working in front-end, back-end, partial scrum master and the occasional DevOps.  I thought I'd be a good fit for the role because not only am I familiar with the tech stack, I am a collaborative problem solver with grit to tackle real life problems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilized Python and its Class Structures to create standard data models (Patients, Providers, Appointments, Encounters, etc.) in order to curate multiple sources of data into digestible structures that we can internally query, audit, and analyze.
Used AWS S3 Buckets. Lambda, and Python libraries such as pandas and frictionless to create a standardization pipeline for aforementioned data models above to automate the processing and curation of received data into our standard models.
Produced numerous Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) using Prefect Flows to automate processes that were run on a schedule such as data ingestion, data model prioritization, orphan data matching, SMS marketing services, etc.
Designed various React components using a combination of AntDesign and CSS using Less.JS in order to enhance user experience when using our client facing application (pages include: a manager page that describes each worker’s statistics, an admin page restricted to personnel with admin access, a feature flagged page that shows purchased campaigns).
Built a suite of GraphQL Queries and Mutations for our platform API requests to efficiently query for necessary data in our complex database and leveraged Apollo to use these queries from the front-end and Graphiql to help test queries.
Leveraged Swagger UI and Flask to generate a suite of REST APIs for querying intelligent campaign data; opting for REST for its superior error handling and efficiency when handling queries such as ones in our data set.
Adopted Twilio’s messaging services to engineer an internal mass SMS messaging service that was capable of sending test messages to assigned phone numbers, sending messages based on priority and daily limit, and auditing the resulting data.
Took on the responsibility of scrum master for designated quarters such as running sprint planning meetings, conducting daily stand ups, organizing sprint retrospectives, and auditing sprint data, while functioning as an individual contributor.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer (Open Source)
positions.description:
- Created an Electron application by leveraging  ipcMain and ipcRenderer to communicate between separate processes in order to develop a multi-platform application that achieved low latency between the communication of separate services
- Generated nodes using D3JS to represent component tree hierarchy to view the relationships between user-generated components and to allow users to observe the expansion or compression of component dependencies in real time.
- Constructed GraphQL schemas to define the structure of prototyped components to take advantage of its natural coupling of types and queries that are shared in components as data in order to create reusable component structures
- Applied Redux as the centralized state management system to avoid unnecessary prop drilling thus allowing for an increased scalability of the application for a large amount of user input data and a smoother user experience
- Employed NodeJS fork method from the child_process module to asynchronously make non-blocking GraphQL queries in order to enhance the overall experience by delivering a seamless, responsive workflow for each client based user
- Implemented Jest and Enzyme to author a collection of unit/integration tests to prevent unexpected outcomes from edge cases, to expedite iteration and feature addition, as well as enforce a stable codebase during every update of the application

positions.title: Vibez - A sentiment analyzer for slack channels | tool for HR
positions.description:
- Used React to establish an interactive user interface that allows for dynamic changes of the state depending on the user’s inputs by taking advantage of its virtual DOM and reusable components to increase loading performance and modularity
- Produced graphs using React Chart.js to provide a user interactive graph structure that allowed for users to see not only the sentiment value in the graph but to interact with the individual messages corresponding to the vertex upon hovering 
- Refactored codebase with React Hooks to increase modularity, reduce duplicate stateful logic, and avoid having to create complex components, thus allowing for faster development and iteration and an overall easier developer experience

positions.title: Movie On - An app to organize current and personalized movie data
positions.description:
- Utilized NodeJS/Express to create a robust server that routes and retrieves user information to and from the database while creating dynamic fetch requests to an API endpoint to achieve a smooth flow of information
- Authenticated using cookies and bcrypt, caching previous sessions to provide information more quickly to previously authenticated users and hiding plaintext user information from potential threats to safeguard user information
- Architected front-end using React Router to establish static routes upon requests to efficiently render a variety of different views, and minimize server requests by capitalizing on React’s virtual DOM to improve loading performance
- Deployed a SQL database using PostgresQL to create authentication tables, and tables that stored, created, deleted and updated each user’s specific information for its ACID compliance and consistent data
